links.effect: Ungated, 29.9% of records contain schema failures and 20.1% contain clinically invalid staging. Schema validation rejects 148 of 512 records, ontology grounding a further 24, staging-logic none.

links.outcome: Effect of retrieval augmentation on gate compliance across generators

screen.reason: The study empirically tests and isolates specific quality-assurance guardrails (schema validation, ontology grounding, staging-logic validation, and retrieval augmentation) applied to LLMs generating synthetic clinical oncology data.
